    token_log_probs = log_probs.gather(2, shift_labels.unsqueeze(-1)).squeeze(-1)

    return token_log_probs[0].cpu().float().numpy()


def _minkpp_score(target_logprobs: np.ndarray, ref_logprobs: np.ndarray,
